outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Trademark & Infringement Litigation page
outreach_draft.body:
Neema, I was looking through Amini & Conant's current site and noticed the firm handles several very different client needs — corporate and commercial work, litigation, real estate, M&A, and trademark/infringement matters — while the website routes those services through the same general Services experience.

For someone specifically dealing with a trademark or infringement dispute, a focused page could give that client a much clearer path from the first click: what you handle, when to involve counsel, and why your team is relevant to that situation. It also gives Google a more focused service context and makes the firm's offering easier for AI-driven discovery tools to understand.

I picked Trademark & Infringement Litigation as the first mockup because it's materially different from the transactional work and deserves its own client conversation.

I'm putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I'll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you'd rather I didn't, just let me know.
